# Checks a repo may turn off in devkit.ini under [skip].
# Format: name | protected | what it covers
# "protected = yes" means the gate refuses to skip it (the kit's reason for existing).
# This file is the single source of truth: docs/config-file.md and the bats
# self-test are checked against it, and every name must be guarded by a
# contains(..., ',<name>,') test in gate.yml or a sub-workflow.

# ── Whole jobs in gate.yml ───────────────────────────────────────────
actionlint            | no  | Lints the repo's own workflow files
secrets-scan          | yes | detect-secrets + trufflehog on the diff and history
ai-provenance         | no  | Detects AI-authored commits and labels the PR
ai-verification       | no  | All AI-pattern checks (see ai-verification.* below)
python                | no  | The whole Python pipeline
typescript            | no  | The whole TypeScript/JavaScript pipeline
java                  | no  | The whole Java pipeline
go                    | no  | The whole Go pipeline
terraform             | no  | The whole Terraform pipeline
docker                | no  | The whole Docker pipeline
shell                 | no  | The whole shell-script pipeline
csharp                | no  | The whole C# pipeline
scorecard             | no  | OpenSSF Scorecard (main tier, public repos)
sbom                  | no  | SBOM generation; also disables attest, which consumes it
attest                | no  | Sigstore attestation of the build artifact
migration-safety      | no  | Destructive DB migration detection (main tier)

# ── Hygiene job steps ────────────────────────────────────────────────
hygiene.identity      | yes | Committer email-domain policy
hygiene.editorconfig  | no  | editorconfig-checker
hygiene.lf            | no  | CRLF shell-script detection
hygiene.pr-size       | no  | PR size guard (soft/hard line limits)
hygiene.commit-msg    | no  | Conventional-commit message lint
hygiene.codeowners    | no  | CODEOWNERS presence/coverage
hygiene.markdownlint  | no  | markdownlint (qa/main tiers)
hygiene.typos         | no  | Typo check (qa/main tiers)

# ── Code-scan job steps ──────────────────────────────────────────────
code-scan.trojan-source | yes | Trojan Source + homoglyph scan
code-scan.mcp-allowlist | no  | MCP server allowlist
code-scan.log-hygiene   | no  | Secrets/PII in log statements

# ── Dep-scan job steps ───────────────────────────────────────────────
dep-scan.cooldown        | no  | Dependency cooldown + confusion
dep-scan.license         | no  | License compliance
dep-scan.vuln-prioritize | no  | KEV + EPSS vulnerability prioritisation
dep-scan.malicious-deps  | yes | OSV malicious-package scan
dep-scan.conftest        | no  | Policy-as-code (Conftest)

# ── AI-verification sub-workflow jobs ────────────────────────────────
ai-verification.agent-rule-scan        | no | Prompt-injection scan of agent rule files
ai-verification.import-existence       | no | Hallucinated-dependency check
ai-verification.exception-swallow      | no | Swallowed-exception detector
ai-verification.test-delta             | no | Code changed without tests
ai-verification.lint-disable           | no | Unjustified lint-disable comments
ai-verification.claude-security-review | no | Claude security review (main tier)

# ── Python sub-workflow jobs/steps ───────────────────────────────────
python.pre-commit     | no | Repo's own pre-commit hooks
python.lint           | no | Ruff / Black
python.type-check     | no | mypy
python.security       | no | Bandit
python.deps-vulns     | no | pip-audit
python.test           | no | pytest
python.diff-coverage  | no | Diff-coverage gate

# ── TypeScript sub-workflow jobs/steps ───────────────────────────────
typescript.lint             | no | Biome or ESLint
typescript.type-check       | no | tsc --noEmit
typescript.security         | no | Semgrep
typescript.deps-vulns       | no | npm audit
typescript.test             | no | Test runner
typescript.diff-coverage    | no | Diff-coverage gate
typescript.build            | no | Production build
typescript.frontend-quality | no | Lighthouse + bundle budgets

# ── Java sub-workflow jobs/steps ─────────────────────────────────────
java.lint           | no | Checkstyle
java.spotbugs       | no | SpotBugs
java.deps-vulns     | no | OWASP Dependency-Check
java.test           | no | Test runner
java.diff-coverage  | no | Diff-coverage gate

# ── Go sub-workflow steps ────────────────────────────────────────────
go.lint           | no | golangci-lint
go.vulncheck      | no | govulncheck
go.build          | no | go build
go.test           | no | go test
go.diff-coverage  | no | Diff-coverage gate

# ── Terraform sub-workflow jobs ──────────────────────────────────────
terraform.fmt-validate | no | terraform fmt + validate
terraform.tflint       | no | tflint
terraform.checkov      | no | Checkov
terraform.plan         | no | terraform plan + PR comment
terraform.trivy-iac    | no | Trivy IaC scan
terraform.infracost    | no | Infracost (main tier)

# ── Docker sub-workflow jobs ─────────────────────────────────────────
docker.hadolint        | no | hadolint
docker.build-and-scan  | no | Build + Trivy image scan + Dockle

# ── Shell sub-workflow jobs ──────────────────────────────────────────

# ── C# sub-workflow jobs/steps ───────────────────────────────────────
